arguments.sql:
SELECT f."Charter Funding Type" AS frpm_funding,
       s.FundingType AS directory_funding,
       COUNT(*) AS enrollment_rows,
       COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS matched_directory_rows,
       COUNT(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS known_differences,
       AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS average_difference
FROM frpm AS f
LEFT JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
GROUP BY f."Charter Funding Type", s.FundingType

item.text: Which column should define “locally funded” for both school selection and the average: `frpm."Charter Funding Type"` or `schools.FundingType`? Both contain `Locally funded`, but they identify different sets of schools.
